geometry_sources.N_16_18_32_34_primary: published B3LYP/6-31G(d) unconstrained neutral-singlet Cartesian coordinates from SC-016-D4SC08225G-s002.zip
geometry_sources.N_8_10_primary: deterministic graph contraction from each published N=12 A/B/C/D parent; remove the most remote ring S-D-S C2H2 unit, repeat as needed; retain the five-membered fused ring
geometry_sources.independent_secondary: RDKit ETKDGv3 embeddings with frozen random seeds and MMFF94s/UFF pre-relaxation
geometry_sources.redistribution_rule: Do not commit the third-party supplement archives; record URLs, hashes and derived-input provenance.

quantum_chemistry.grid_identity: Gaussian FineGrid-equivalent numerical alignment; the 2025 source does not report an explicit non-default grid
quantum_chemistry.frequency: analytic Hessian; minimum requires zero imaginary frequencies
quantum_chemistry.pilot_geometry_acceleration: GFN2-xTB pre-optimization followed by density-fitted B3LYPG/6-31G(d) geometry optimization on a 50x194 grid; final energy and analytic Hessian use the frozen direct 75x302 protocol
quantum_chemistry.source_reconstruction_role: Published B3LYP/6-31G(d) EE+ZPVE values are external anchors, not substitutes for newly calculated N=8/10 values.

conformer_search.attempt_semantics: initial batch size; extend deterministically in batches of 8 only when the preregistered final-four stopping rule is not met
conformer_search.stop_rule: Both registered sources attempted and no new unique candidate within 1.0 kcal/mol in the final four ETKDG attempts.

protocol_amendment.reason: The initial eight-attempt audit showed late qualifying discoveries for multiple systems. Eight is therefore treated as the frozen initial batch, not as permission to declare the stopping rule passed.
protocol_amendment.allowed_action: Append deterministic eight-attempt batches up to 32; retain every attempt and do not select the attempt count by agreement with the monograph.

search_fallback.trigger: The deterministic ETKDG audit reaches 32 attempts and still finds a new unique candidate within 1.0 kcal/mol in the final four attempts.
search_fallback.scope: Only triggered N/species identities; the CREST best geometry is evaluated by the same final PySCF protocol and competes with all registered candidates.
search_fallback.selection_rule: Lowest final PySCF electronic energy; CREST prescreen energy never becomes the scientific label.

gate_v2_4p.expansion_policy: No N=8..34 expansion until this paired-pilot gate is passed by generated evidence and a separate post-gate expansion approval is recorded.
